• The Fieschi Fiefs rise again! Thanks to intense work lasting many months, coordinated within the Antica Via del Cifalco project and completed thanks to the hands-on involvement of volunteers, the Itinerario dei Feudi Fliscani (IFF), on the stretch between Neirone and Gattorna, has been made passable again. This follows the earlier recovery of the higher stretch, between Neirone and Monte Lavagnola (outside the Via del Cifalco, but of undoubted natural interest). Our thanks go to the friends of the Cifalco Gianni de Billio, Stefano Privitera and Paola Terzi for their decisive contribution – all the credit goes to them. Much remains to be done: clearing rubbish, routine maintenance and so on, but the way is open. The tarmac stretch between Neirone and Gattorna remains marked on the map as a possible variant.
  • The Municipality of Tribogna has issued ordinance no. 19 of 16 December 2025, which prohibits passage along the path on the stretch near Cassanesi; should this ordinance still be in force at the time of your hike, complying with it would mean going back down a few hundred metres to the last point where the path cuts across the tarmac road (to be taken to the right for those coming back from the point where the path is barred, and to the left for those going up), and then following the “red bar and red circle” waymark, turning off to the right just after the Madia trattoria.
